name: Stock Plate Details
query:
SELECT
    sp.name AS "ID:Data:120",
    sp.parent AS "Stock Item:Link/Stock Item:150",
    sp.category AS "Category:Data:120",
    sp.type AS "Type:Data:120",
    sp.moc AS "MOC:Data:120",
    sp.vendor AS "Vendor:Link/Supplier:150",
    sp.purchase_order_no AS "Purchase Order No:Data:150",
    sp.description AS "Description:Data:200",
    sp.length AS "Length:Float:100",
    sp.width AS "Width:Float:100",
    sp.thickness AS "Thickness:Float:100",
    sp.density AS "Density:Float:100",
    sp.quantity AS "Quantity:Float:100",
    sp.rate_per_kg AS "Rate Per Kg:Currency:120",
    sp.used_weight AS "Used Weight:Float:120",
    sp.weight_per_item AS "Weight Per Item:Float:130",
    sp.actual_weight AS "Actual Weight:Float:120",
    sp.available_weight AS "Available Weight:Float:130",
    sp.actual_weight_amount AS "Actual Weight Amount:Currency:150",
    sp.available_weight_amount AS "Available Weight Amount:Currency:160",
    sp.used_weight_percentage AS "Used Weight %:Percent:120",
    sp.status AS "Status:Data:120",
    sp.reference_image AS "Reference Image:Data:150"

FROM `tabStock Plate details` sp

WHERE
    sp.parenttype = 'Stock Item'

    AND (
        %(stock_item)s IS NULL
        OR %(stock_item)s = ''
        OR sp.parent = %(stock_item)s
    )

    AND (
        %(category)s IS NULL
        OR %(category)s = ''
        OR sp.category = %(category)s
    )

    AND (
        %(type)s IS NULL
        OR %(type)s = ''
        OR sp.type = %(type)s
    )

    AND (
        %(moc)s IS NULL
        OR %(moc)s = ''
        OR sp.moc = %(moc)s
    )

    AND (
        %(vendor)s IS NULL
        OR %(vendor)s = ''
        OR sp.vendor = %(vendor)s
    )

    AND (
        %(status)s IS NULL
        OR %(status)s = ''
        OR sp.status = %(status)s
    )

ORDER BY sp.modified DESC
